display_long_description:
Step into Big Fear, an immersive VR experience where creativity, fear, and freedom collide. This is more than just a game—it’s a constantly evolving sandbox where you choose how you play, what you create, and how brave you’re willing to be.

Explore a wide variety of gameplay styles all in one place. Test your skills in intense obstacle challenges inspired by “Only Up”-style progression, where every step forward matters and one mistake can send you falling back down. Or break the rules entirely by entering zero gravity mode, where movement feels completely different and the environment becomes your playground.

For players who love thrills, Big Fear delivers heart-pounding horror experiences. Run, hide, and survive as terrifying monsters hunt you through dark environments. Each level is designed to keep you on edge, forcing quick thinking and fast reactions if you want to escape. Whether you’re navigating eerie hallways or escaping relentless creatures, the fear feels real in VR.

But the experience doesn’t stop there—you can also become a content creator inside the game. Build your own worlds, design unique challenges, or create custom horror scenarios for others to play. Share your creations, explore what others have built, and be part of a growing community that keeps the game fresh and unpredictable.

Key Features:

Sandbox gameplay with multiple modes and experiences
“Only Up”-style climbing and parkour challenges
Zero gravity mode for unique movement and exploration
